partner_result_applied.scope: Target-level lower bound C>=3sqrt(2) from diffuse uniform block averages.

mathematical_change.statement: Every fixed spanning periodic rank-three cube frame with iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2] physical coordinates has p_Q(0)=3sqrt(2)[1-(1/(20m))sum_j E_J(v_j)+O(m^-2)], where E_J(v)=57s^2/32+15st/4+3t^2/4>0. Thus the Gaussian lower-bound ceiling is approached from below for every fixed periodic pattern.
mathematical_change.universal_first_order_deficit: sum_j E_J(v_j)>=27/(4r), hence relative deficit >=27/(80rm)=27/(80n) at first order.

unresolved_implication: No universal upper bound for arbitrary bounded-density product laws is proved. A witness above 3sqrt(2), if one exists, must leave the fixed-period diffuse uniform-cube Edgeworth regime.
next_step: Attack nonperiodic/mesoscopic frames or non-uniform density-one supports, or obtain a target-level upper bound that exploits product provenance beyond Gaussian/periodic limits.
